description: Access Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Contacts, Sheets, Docs, Tasks, and other Google services via the `gog` CLI. Use whenever the user mentions email, calendar, schedule, drive, documents, spreadsheets, contacts, tasks, or anything Google Workspace-related. Triggers on: "check my email," "what's on my calendar," "search my gmail," "send an email," "find a doc," "look up a contact," "my schedule," "upcoming events," "unread mail," "create an event," "what did I get from [person]," "search drive," "check my tasks," "school email," "Brown email," or any request involving Google data. Also use when composing, replying to, or drafting emails.
